tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Envelope of a complete integral for $u^2(1+|Du|^2)=1$] ↗ thm:envelope-solves-pde 1. ch3:3.1-ex-4\group Nonlinear First-Order PDE

The family \[ u(x,a)=\pm \sqrt{1-|x-a|^2} \] solves $u^2(1+|Du|^2)=1$. The stationarity equation $D_a u=0$ gives $a=x$, so its envelopes are the singular solutions $v\equiv \pm 1$. \end{example}
